newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian firm in Russian archive film deal.
newsitem.headline: Australian firm in Russian archive film deal.

text.p: A small Australian firm, National Investment Ltd, said on Tuesday it plans to market archive film of Russia from the last 70 years after an agreement with Russian state film archives Gosfilmofond.

"These films include documentaries, motion pictures, footage and other materials of Russian, Soviet and foreign origin and have been carefully collected during the 70 years of the archives' existence," the company said in a statement to the Australian Stock Exchange (ASX).

National Investment and Gosfilmofond signed a preliminary deal in Moscow for a distribution deal for the Australian group to market worldwide, with the exception of eastern Europe, all films presently held in the Gosfilmofond archives.

Amongst the footage is film of the ballet, theatre and the arts along with rare footage in the archives which was captured from the Nazis during the World War Two battle for Moscow, National Investment said.
Many films cover the early period of Russian cinematic life including the period when Russia was governed by the Tsars.

As part of the agreement, National Investment will finance the transfer of the celluloid films held in the archives to video tapes to make the films more saleable for western movie use while permanently preserving for Gosfilmofond the archival films which in many cases contain important historical information, the company said.
